props.name: animation
props.description: Entry and update animations, skipped when the user prefers reduced motion (default `true`)

props.name: deep
props.description:
Also follows in-place mutations of nested data (`series[0].data.push()`);
by default the chart updates when a prop is replaced (cheaper on large data)

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend; clicking an item hides / shows its slice, stage or series (shown by default for pie, donut, funnel and multi-series radar charts)

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip; `false` disables it (default `true`)

props.name: ticks
props.description: Tick labels at the ends and at the band bounds (default `true`)

props.name: needle
props.description: Draws a needle in addition to the value arc

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the value arc when there are no bands (default: the first palette color)

props.name: renderer
props.description: Backend of the shapes: `auto` tries WebGPU, then WebGL2, then WebGL, then Canvas2D, skipping GPUs running in software; text is always drawn with Canvas2D (default `auto`, see `setDefaultChartRenderer`)

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels (default `100%`)

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the chart (the legend included); numbers are pixels, strings any CSS length

props.name: padding
props.description: Space around the drawing, in pixels (default 8 on every side)

props.name: palette
props.description: Colors of the marks without `color` (defaults to the `--chart-series-1..8` CSS variables, then the theme colors)

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the chart (default: the chart type, e.g. "Donut chart")

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale of the texts and numbers the engine writes (tooltip rows, accessible names, compact numbers); the page language by default

props.name: max
props.description: Value at the end of the arc (default 100)

props.name: min
props.description: Value at the start of the arc (default 0)

props.name: value
props.description: Value shown by the arc (clamped to `min` - `max` for the drawing)

props.name: label
props.description: Caption under the value

props.name: hidden
props.description:
Hidden slices / stages / radar series / top-level treemap nodes, by
index. Makes the visibility controlled: legend clicks then only emit
`toggle`, whose `hiddenIndexes` should be stored and passed back.

props.name: texts
props.description: Replaces built-in texts of the `locale` (tooltip rows, accessible names, "No data")

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the values of the labels and the tooltip (default: compact numbers, 1.2k, 3.4M)

props.name: percentFormat
props.description: Formats the shares (labels, conversion rates, tooltip); `share` is 0-1 (default: one decimal, "40.0%")

props.name: thickness
props.description: Thickness of the arc as a fraction of the radius (default 0.16)

props.name: sweep
props.description: Total angle of the arc, degrees (default 240)

props.name: bands
props.description: Colored ranges of the track; the value arc takes the color of its band

<script setup lang="ts">
// Colored bands split the track; the value arc takes the color of its band.
import { computed } from "vue";
import { useI18n } from "minerva-design/vue";
import { GaugeChart } from "minerva-design/vue/charts";

const TEXT = {
  en: "CPU load",
  zh: "CPU 负载",
  ja: "CPU 負荷",
  fr: "Charge CPU",
};

const bands = [
  { to: 60, color: "var(--success-color, #16a34a)" },
  { to: 85, color: "var(--warning-color, #f59e0b)" },
  { to: 100, color: "var(--danger-color, #dc2626)" },
];
const { language } = useI18n();
const label = computed(() => TEXT[language.value] ?? TEXT.en);
const format = (value: number) => `${value}%`;
</script>

<template>
  <GaugeChart :value="72" :label="label" :bands="bands" :format="format" />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
// `needle` adds a pointer to the arc; `min` / `max` set the scale, `sweep`
// and `thickness` the shape of the arc.
import { computed } from "vue";
import { useI18n } from "minerva-design/vue";
import { GaugeChart } from "minerva-design/vue/charts";

const TEXT = {
  en: "Speed (km/h)",
  zh: "速度（公里/小时）",
  ja: "速度（km/h）",
  fr: "Vitesse (km/h)",
};

const { language } = useI18n();
const label = computed(() => TEXT[language.value] ?? TEXT.en);
</script>

<template>
  <GaugeChart
    :value="128"
    :max="200"
    :label="label"
    needle
    :sweep="270"
    :thickness="0.1"
    :height="260"
  />
</template>

translationResources.title: 仪表盘
translationResources.description: 在弧线上展示单个数值及其所处的量程，可配合彩色阈值区间：KPI、资源使用率、评分等。value 变化时，弧线（和指针）会从当前位置平滑过渡。

basic.title: 基础
basic.description: 三个小仪表盘，各自设置颜色、标签和格式。

bands.title: 区间与指针
bands.description: bands 按区间为轨道着色（红、黄、绿），数值弧取所在区间的颜色；needle 指向当前值，min 可以为负数。

live.title: 实时数值
live.description: 定时器每 1.5 秒更新一次 value，仪表盘以动画过渡到新值；sweep={180} 绘制半圆，thickness 加粗弧线。暂停或卸载时会清除定时器。

speedometer.title: 速度表
speedometer.description: 细弧线加指针的仪表盘；按住按钮（或 Space / Enter）加速或刹车。animation={false} 让指针直接跟随状态，单位由 Intl.NumberFormat 提供。

quota.title: 配额用量
quota.description: 每项套餐配额一个仪表盘，在各自上限的 75% 和 90% 处分段，ticks={false}，下方说明已用量与上限。

slo.title: 可用性与错误预算
slo.description: 一个放大刻度的仪表盘（min 99.5，max 100）显示可用性与目标的对比，另一个显示剩余的错误预算；renderTooltip 给出详细信息。

thermostat.title: 智能温控器
thermostat.description: − 和 + 按钮每次将目标温度调整半度；设置以 °C 存储并在显示时换算，因此切换到 °F 时 value、min、max 和 bands 会一起变化。renderTooltip 显示室温，下方文字说明系统正在制热、制冷还是保持。

credit-score.title: 信用评分
credit-score.description: 指针位于 300 到 850 的五个评级区间上，min 和 max 设置为评分的量程。通过 Select 切换申请人时指针会扫向新的分数；renderTooltip 显示评级，event.percent 给出在量程中的位置。

battery.title: 电动汽车充电
battery.description: 插电时半圆仪表盘（sweep={180}）每 400 毫秒填充一次，超过 80% 后变慢；拔出、充满或卸载时停止计时器。只播报充电阶段；续航里程和充到 80% 的时间使用 Intl.NumberFormat 的单位格式。

dark-panel.title: 深色控制面板
dark-panel.description: 三个带指针的仪表盘位于一个面板上，其 CSS 变量会切换为深色主题。图表只监听 <html> 和 <body>，因此在重新设置容器样式后，示例通过 ref 对每个图表调用 refreshTheme()。

GaugeChartProps.value: 弧线显示的数值（绘制时限制在 min - max 之间）
GaugeChartProps.label: 数值下方的说明文字
GaugeChartProps.sweep: 弧线的总角度，单位为度
GaugeChartProps.thickness: 弧线粗细占半径的比例
GaugeChartProps.bands: 轨道上的彩色区间；数值弧取所在区间的颜色
GaugeChartProps.color: 没有 bands 时数值弧的颜色
GaugeChartProps.needle: 在数值弧之外再绘制一根指针
GaugeChartProps.ticks: 在两端（以及区间边界处）显示刻度标签

GaugeBand.to: 区间上界（下界为前一个区间的上界或 min）

basic.title: 基础用法
basic.description: 在 240° 圆弧上显示一个数值；format 将其写成百分比。

bands.title: 色带与指针
bands.description: bands 为轨道和数值弧着色；按钮修改 value，圆弧和指针会以动画过渡到新值。

bands.title: 彩色区间
bands.description: 三个区间划分轨道；数值弧使用其终点所在区间的颜色。

needle.title: 指针与自定义刻度
needle.description: 0–200 刻度上的指针，扫描角更大，弧更细。

props.height: 图表高度（包含图例）：像素值或任意 CSS 长度
props.options: 其他引擎选项（坐标轴、图例、提示框、调色板、格式化……），与元素自身的属性合并；仅作为属性设置
props.instance: 引擎实例（minerva-design/charts/core），在元素渲染并连接到文档之前为 null

events.minerva-hover: 悬停（或键盘聚焦）的图形元素发生变化；detail：{ index, name, value, share }，无悬停时为 null
events.minerva-click: 点击、轻触或按 Enter 激活了一个图形元素；detail：{ index, name, value, share }
events.minerva-toggle: 点击了图例项（或调用了 toggle()）；detail：{ index, hidden, hiddenIndexes }

methods.toggle: 按索引隐藏或显示扇区、阶段、雷达系列或树图的顶层节点
methods.getRenderer: 绘制图形所用的后端（webgpu、webgl2、webgl、canvas2d），就绪前为 null；可通过引擎选项 renderer 指定
